$comment: Which client-only tags a network will carry, shared by tests/shared/clienttags.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. Neither client read CLIENTTAGDENY, so on Libera a reaction went out, had its tag stripped in passing, and arrived as a TAGMSG that meant nothing — no reaction, no error, and a button that appeared to work. The values here are the ones those networks actually send.
$carries: `deny` is the CLIENTTAGDENY token; `tag` is a client tag without its `+`.

carries.name: a network that says nothing carries everything
Libera does not carry the draft spelling of typing
FurNet carries both spellings of typing
FurNet carries the draft spelling of reply
FurNet does not carry the short spelling of reply
a list without a star denies only what it names

$choose: Two names exist for most of these while the drafts settle. `use` is the first spelling the network will carry, or null when it will carry none.

choose.name: Libera takes the short spelling of typing
FurNet needs the draft spelling of reply
neither spelling of react gets through Libera
a network that says nothing takes the first
